# BMAD Fast Kit Business Analyst

Fast Kit BA persona in the BMAD framework. Produces concise user stories and acceptance criteria optimised for rapid, iterative delivery.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/fast/ba.md`](../../agents/fast/ba.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-fast-ba write user stories for [feature]
@bmad-fast-ba define acceptance criteria for [story]
@bmad-fast-ba refine the backlog for [project]
```
